title: Scaffold: update requirements.txt with all 7 deps, verify src/config.yaml exists, ensure src/ and tests/ packages
acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt contains all 7 deps. pip install -r requirements.txt exits 0.

title: Implement config module: Pydantic nested models, validators, from_yaml loader in src/config.py
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic v2 nested config with validators and from_yaml loader. Loads user's config correctly.

title: Challenger: independent config module variant in src/config_challenger.py
acceptance_criteria: Dataclass-based config with manual YAML parsing. Same public API. Loads user's config correctly.

title: Critic: test config validation, YAML loading, defaults, edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Tests parametrized over both implementations. 33 acceptance tests pass. Breaking tests found 5 edge-case bugs (filed as BUG-F1-* tasks).

title: Fix executor config edge cases: bool port coercion, null tickers, malformed YAML TypeError
acceptance_criteria: Fix 3 edge cases in src/config.py: (1) Boolean port (flight_port: true) must raise ValueError, not silently coerce to 1; (2) tickers: null and exclude_tickers: null must return [] not raise ValidationError; (3) Malformed top-level YAML list must raise ValueError, not TypeError. tests/test_config_breaking.py tests D1, D2, D3, D5 for executor:src.config must PASS. python -m pytest tests/test_config_breaking.py -v exit 0 for executor params.

title: Fix challenger config edge case: db_path does not create duckdb_dir
acceptance_criteria: Fix db_path property in src/config_challenger.py to create duckdb_dir if absent (spec: 'Created if absent'). test_db_path_creates_duckdb_dir_if_absent for challenger:src.config_challenger must PASS. python -m pytest tests/test_config_breaking.py::test_db_path_creates_duckdb_dir_if_absent -v exit 0.

title: Implement DatabaseManager: schema init, upsert, read-only conn, write lock, split tracking, ticker detection, report query
acceptance_criteria: src/db.py defines DatabaseManager with all methods from spec §10: _init_schema (creates daily_quotes with Volume DOUBLE, splits_processed, schema_version tables), _read_only_conn, execute_query (returns pa.Table), upsert_dataframe (MERGE INTO, returns int row count), purge_ticker, is_split_processed, record_split, delete_ticker_data, get_existing_tickers, get_aligned_start_date, detect_new_tickers, generate_top_20_dollar_volume, close (CHECKPOINT). Uses threading.Lock for all writes. Read-only conn for reads. python -c "from src.db import DatabaseManager; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Challenger: independent DatabaseManager variant in src/db_challenger.py
acceptance_criteria: src/db_challenger.py defines DatabaseManager with same public API as F2-T1. Structurally different implementation (e.g. connection pool vs single conn, different lock strategy, different SQL parameter binding style, or context manager pattern). Same acceptance test passes. python -c "from src.db_challenger import DatabaseManager; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Critic: test DatabaseManager with temp DuckDB files in tests/test_db.py
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_db.py parametrized over BOTH src.db.DatabaseManager and src.db_challenger.DatabaseManager. Tests with tmp_path-isolated DuckDB: (1) schema creates 3 tables (daily_quotes, splits_processed, schema_version); (2) upsert inserts new rows; (3) upsert updates existing rows (MERGE); (4) upsert empty df returns 0, no error; (5) read-only conn rejects DELETE; (6) detect_new_tickers returns correct diff; (7) get_aligned_start_date returns MIN(Date) or None; (8) generate_top_20 returns sorted by dollar_volume DESC limit 20; (9) record_split + is_split_processed idempotency; (10) delete_ticker_data removes all rows for ticker; (11) thread safety: concurrent writes don't corrupt. python -m pytest tests/test_db.py -v exits 0. Critic pastes pytest output to EVENTS.log.

title: Implement IngestionEngine: batch download, split detection (DELETE+re-download), normalize, run_initial_load, run_daily_load, run_on_request_load
acceptance_criteria: src/ingestion.py defines IngestionEngine with all methods from spec §10: __init__(db_mgr, cfg), _check_and_apply_splits (per-ticker split detection via yf.Ticker.splits, DELETE + re-download from aligned start with auto_adjust=True), _batch_download (yf.download with end+1 day fix, auto_adjust=True, group_by='ticker'), _normalize_batch_df (handles multi-ticker and single-ticker, drops NaN, purges excluded empty tickers, warns on non-excluded empty), fetch_and_clean (split check + batch download + normalize), run_initial_load (6-year default, returns dict with rows_upserted/tickers_succeeded/tickers_failed/errors/duration_ms), run_daily_load (NYSE calendar check via pandas_market_calendars, new ticker detection + backfill from aligned start, trailing 4-day refresh, returns dict), run_on_request_load (custom tickers+dates, returns dict). python -c "from src.ingestion import IngestionEngine; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Challenger: independent IngestionEngine variant in src/ingestion_challenger.py
acceptance_criteria: src/ingestion_challenger.py defines IngestionEngine with same public API as F3-T1. Structurally different implementation (e.g. different download retry strategy, different normalization pipeline, different split detection order, different error handling structure). Same acceptance tests pass. python -c "from src.ingestion_challenger import IngestionEngine; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Critic: test IngestionEngine with mocked yfinance in tests/test_ingestion.py
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_ingestion.py parametrized over BOTH src.ingestion.IngestionEngine and src.ingestion_challenger.IngestionEngine. Mock yf.download and yf.Ticker.splits. Tests: (1) _batch_download adds +1 day to end_date; (2) fetch_and_clean returns (df, succeeded, failed, errors) tuple; (3) split detection: unprocessed split -> delete + re-download; (4) already-processed split -> skip; (5) multiple splits -> single re-download; (6) empty ticker in exclude_list -> purge; (7) empty ticker NOT in exclude_list -> warning, no purge; (8) run_daily_load: new ticker detection + backfill from aligned start; (9) run_daily_load: empty DB -> initial_load + trailing refresh; (10) run_daily_load: market closed -> SKIPPED. python -m pytest tests/test_ingestion.py -v exits 0. Critic pastes pytest output to EVENTS.log.
